evidence.assessment: Only the second settings/read response is controlled with a deferred promise. The test now explicitly observes disabled save and preserved false choice while the read is pending, clicks the disabled save, and requires no settings/write. Resolving v2 inside awaited act settles the normal fetched-data confirm/compared reset before user review; the production effect is not bypassed or stubbed.

Before comparison, adoption must be disabled and clicking it must leave the conflict visible. Saving still cannot write and the selected value remains false. The test then explicitly checks comparison, waits for the actual enabled adoption button, clicks it, and requires the conflict to disappear. This directly observes successful adoption instead of assuming it from a click.

Adopting v2 must leave fresh confirmation unchecked and save disabled. A disabled save click still produces no write. Only a new explicit confirmation followed by an enabled save may dispatch, with exact expectedVersion v2 and the single memories.use_memories=false leaf change. The added exact-one settings/write assertion retains the original no-replay requirement. Existing unique-layer and unknown-receipt tests remain unchanged.

limitations: The test covers a fetched user-version change, not a real upstream rejection response or live configuration write.
CI2 remains a failed complete PR run; local targeted passes and this review do not constitute a complete hosted pass. CI3 must verify the new candidate.
